demos.name: Agent Privilege Client LAB
demos.description: A local, no-login test client for an OAuth-protected MCP gateway. Shows one tool call through the gateway and directly, so the policy difference is visible.

demos.name: MCP Demo Client for Privilege LAB
demos.description: Chat-first local MCP demo client for protected MCP demos behind a PingOne Privilege gateway.

demos.name: Privilege A2A Anthropic demo LAB
demos.description: Three Node processes that show an access review through A2A and MCP, on Anthropic or Google models.

demos.name: ID-JAG Standalone LAB
demos.description: Token exchange with ID-JAG, using a mock authorization server and a sample MCP server.

demos.name: Privilege demo LAB
demos.description: An AI agent's MCP tool calls pass a policy enforcement point that decides allow, deny or hold with Cedar. Runs offline in mock mode (in-process mock issuer and tool backends) or verifies Bearer tokens from your own PingFederate in live mode.

demos.name: Privilege Map LAB
demos.description: The PingOne Privilege Federated Identity model as ReactFlow diagrams you can drag and walk through, plus 21 Privilege feature cards, stories and a talk track. Mock only.

demos.name: Agent Meets the MCP Door LAB
demos.description: A member's own AI agent reaches an enterprise MCP door: discover, register, consent, per-call token exchange, gateway, policy decision, human approval, audit. Movable React Flow sequence diagram with a payload or mock token under each message, talk track and presenter mode. Mock only.

demos.name: PingOne Sign-in LAB
demos.description: Sign-in behaviour, mock only: failures, lockout, replay, MFA, step-up (RFC 9470) and CIBA with a mock phone. For real PingOne response shapes and live tenant runs, see the pingone-LAB repo.

demos.name: PingOne LAB
demos.description: A card for each thing PingOne advertises in its discovery document: pi.flow sign-in, PKCE, PAR, JAR, client credentials, token lifecycle, Userinfo, device authorization, CIBA, token exchange, plus a playground. Mock PingOne by default, or your own environment.

demos.name: PingFederate LAB
demos.description: A card for each PingFederate feature behind AI agents: pi.flow sign-in, DCR, RAR with PAR, CIBA, DPoP, token exchange, Userinfo, PAR, PKCE and a protocol playground. Built-in mock PingFederate (offline) or your own PingFederate (live).

demos.name: Customer Agent LAB
demos.description: The customer-facing AI agent with all 87 of its use cases in eight tracks: delegation with an act claim, authorize decisions, step-up and human approval, gateway attacks and refusals. A simulation: a mock engine produces every token and hop offline.

demos.name: Agent Kill Switch
demos.description: How an organization stops a runaway AI agent: rate and cost caps that trip automatically, an operator kill switch that revokes access, and the next call failing. Fully mocked; nothing real is touched.

demos.name: Agent Registry Lifecycle
demos.description: Register an AI agent as a non-human identity, grant it to a tool, rotate it by replacement, retire it, and watch the gateway refuse it (401/403/429). Mock only.

demos.name: AI Guard Sidecar
demos.description: How an external guardrail sidecar plugs into an agent gateway: a stand-in detector, per-category block thresholds, PII rails, a fail-closed toggle and a fault injector. Contract unverified; offline.

demos.name: Agent attack gallery
demos.description: Ten named attacks, including MCP authorization attacks, each run ungoverned and governed against an in-process mock stack: see what the attacker gets, then the control that refuses it.

demos.name: CIMD Lab
demos.description: Teaches OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents both ways: real PingFederate as the authorization server (owner-run, no mock), and the lab's own teaching server with a tester that breaks the document in a dozen ways. PingFederate acting as a CIMD client is UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Diagram Studio
demos.description: Pick or edit a flow diagram stored as data: move boxes, Simulate the arrows, change the speed, Reset, undo, tidy, present, embed, and export as JSON, SVG, PNG or one offline HTML file.

demos.name: Gateway Claims Lab
demos.description: What gateway v1.261024 added, in mock: a nested-claim gate (client_id + act.sub via RequiredClaims, including the act-as-text trap) and an AgentCore gateway posture view (shape only, values invented), plus two H2 2026 release tabs (on-behalf-of RFC 8693 exchange, AgentCore gateway governance...

demos.name: Hostile A2A / poisoned Agent Card
demos.description: A deliberately hostile A2A agent, an offline delegating generalist, and a pinned-card client shown side by side with an ungoverned one: the card told my agent to include my token.

demos.name: Hostile MCP / rug-pull
demos.description: A deliberately hostile MCP server, an offline victim, and a pinned client shown side by side with an ungoverned one: the tool that changed overnight.

demos.name: MCP Auth Conformance Lab
demos.description: Score a mock MCP server with selectable defects (or, in a gated read-only probe, one URL you type) against the MCP authorization expectations, with a sourced reference of what ChatGPT and other clients need.

demos.name: MCP Discovery
demos.description: Read-only MCP discovery: finds MCP servers, probes tool metadata, flags poisoned or changed metadata (rug-pull). Demo mode: fixtures and stubs only. Plus simulated Ping H2 2026 claims (private network, slide 44 personal agents), UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: No tool, no promise
demos.description: A support agent can only commit the company through a tool. Same scripted agent, two tool sets, and a commitment ledger that only tools can write. Mock only: no tenant, no LLM.

demos.name: P1 Third-Party Exchange
demos.description: PingOne token exchange (RFC 8693) that accepts a third-party signed JWT (PingFederate, another PingOne environment, Okta, Auth0, RFC 9068, Microsoft) as the actor token: trusted issuer, assignment, claim mapping, the checks and PingOne's measured refusal texts. Mock only.

demos.name: Personal Agent Flow
demos.description: How an AI assistant reaches a member's benefits through an MCP gateway in twelve steps: discovery, CIMD, consent, signed code exchange, gateway check, policy decision. React Flow sequence diagram, mock token JSON, simulated approval modal, talk track. Mock only.

demos.name: PingGateway Route Lab (simulated)
demos.description: Simulated evaluator, not real PingGateway: which route a request matches and why, the empty-first-param WWW-Authenticate bug, RFC 9728 metadata lint and an RFC 7662 introspection stub. Mock only.

demos.name: Token Workbench
demos.description: Mock-only token workbench: decode and trace a token, test wrong-token rejection, check stub authorization servers against OAuth rules (FAPI 2.0 pack UNVERIFIED), compare PAR/RAR/DPoP/mTLS/JAR/PKCE (simulation).

demos.name: Worker Agent Demo
demos.description: A worker agent acting for a person: attended, delegated (agent to agent) and unattended runs, every tool call through a policy enforcement point that allows, denies or holds for approval; plus an H2 2026 section simulating AgentCard discovery and A2A scope separation (Ping release claims,...

demos.name: Session Lab: PingOne and DaVinci sessions and cookies
demos.description: See the session cookie, the DaVinci sessionToken and the tokens apps hold, then change the session (revoke, shorten idle timeout, require mfa step-up, reuse a sessionToken in a widget) and watch what each app does. React Flow diagram, talk track and presenter mode. Mock only.

demos.name: Intent / PAR Inspector
demos.description: Push an authorization request to a mock server (RFC 9126), watch the intent get bound into the request_uri, consent and token, and see tampering, replay and expiry refused.

demos.name: Poppy Agent Tester
demos.description: Play the personal agent from the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy, Draft 0.3): read a Company's poppy.json, sign in to a real PingFederate with a URL as the client id and PKCE, then call the Company API with a signed Poppy-Session. Every request and token is shown raw.

demos.name: Intent, Purpose and Behaviour Lab
demos.description: Three signals asked of every call (intent, purpose, behaviour), plus on-behalf-of and ID-JAG token flows, as a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine with real RS256 signing. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: Coding Agents LAB
demos.description: Inspection inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and Antigravity through each agent's own hook interface, answered in native allow, deny or ask. A simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims, in mock tables or a Live local hook run. Claims are UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: Data Protection LAB
demos.description: AIGuard content inspection in and out with graduated outcomes, your own gitleaks-format rules, personal-data kinds with checksums, Agent Insights, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, and sealed prompt logging with a key made in your browser. Simulates the 2026-11-02 release claims; all UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: SaaS Access LAB
demos.description: Just-in-time, time-bound access to GitHub, GitLab, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks and Google Workspace, with approval chains, blocked self-approval, an expiry reaper, receipts and drift detection, for humans and agents. Mock or Live local. Simulates the 2026-11-02 release claims, UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Agent Governance LAB
demos.description: AI Platform Agents: cross-cloud inventory of 13 sources, a five-level permission review, custodian approval before any action, remediation, a safe sync that never mistakes silence for deletion, AgentCore gateway governance and private-network discovery. Mock or Live. All product claims UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: MCP Surface LAB
demos.description: The MCP gateway in front of every MCP server: aggregate policy caps, entitlement-aware discovery, OpenAPI to MCP, five backend credential modes, a verified-server catalog, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and CIMD, approval-gated creation. Simulates the 2026-11-02 release claims. Mock or Live. UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Federated Identity LAB
demos.description: Simulates the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims for Federated Identity (short-lived tokens, issuer, subject and audience binding, lifetimes, key refresh, revocation) and Self-Hosted Agents, with real local RS256 verification. Mock tables or a Live local engine. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Secrets Vault LAB
demos.description: A per-user credential vault (self-service, no administrator override, real AES-256-GCM, injected by a simulated gateway) and secret store management over five mock providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Delinea, CyberArk). Mock or Live mode. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: AI Policies LAB
demos.description: Scope and HITL: four layered scope checks (surface, application, action, end user) on a real RS256 token you mint locally, a call held for a person, single-use approvals bound to the exact call, fail closed. Simulates release claims, all UNVERIFIED. Mock tables or a Live local engine.
